title: Final institutional intelligence repair -- repaired-chain evaluation over the frozen Run-002 canonical cohort
baseline: Run-002 artifacts are the immutable diagnostic baseline (historical_validation/run002/, baseline_manifest_run002.json); nothing here writes to or re-reads them for numerics.
cohort_rule: IDENTICAL to Run-002: all canonical lessons with event_date >= 2015-06-01, chronological order, no subsampling, no manual case selection. The 133 ID list is copied verbatim from baseline_manifest_run002.json cohort_verification.included_episode_ids.

FULL_TECH.description: repaired FULL memory + technical desk evidence + as-of market RR

NO_HISTORY_TECH.description: memory ablation with technical desk and market RR active

FULL_NO_TECH.description: memory ablation of the technical desk reading

design_freeze.note: All semantic choices below were fixed from architectural audit BEFORE any Run-003 measurement. None is fitted to Run-002 or Run-003 outcomes.
design_freeze.evidence_direction: weighted-mass direction (existing composite_weight masses); mixed splits evenly; exact balance = mixed
design_freeze.consensus: Beta(1,1) posterior mean of weighted directional agreement (CONSENSUS_PRIOR_MASS = 1.0, chosen a priori as the uniform prior)
design_freeze.neutral_semantics: uninformative: no vote, no dilution, no thesis support; neutral thesis = absence claim with zero support
design_freeze.same_fact_identity: canonical_fact_identity = existing primitive_fact_id(asset, event_type, as_of date)
design_freeze.memory_desk: ONE HISTORICAL_MEMORY evidence item per adjudication; bias = uniform positive/negative mapping (Correction 033 vocabulary); confidence = mean retrieval similarity; desk regime_weight 0.8 (existing default)
design_freeze.technical_desk: ONE TECHNICAL evidence item when the existing TechnicalResearchDesk produces a directional reading; regime_weight 0.8; degraded/non-directional -> no item
design_freeze.regime_treatment: REGIME_EXPECTED_BIAS archived: W7 regime_conflict disabled, W9 regime_alignment channel removed, W10 regime_blindness disabled. No as-of regime-conditional outcome archive exists; fitting one was out of scope.

market_rr.ratio: (adverse mass * adverse move) / (favorable mass * favorable move)

design_freeze.a_priori_note: VOL_LOOKBACK=60 / VOL_MIN_OBS=30 follow the standard short-horizon RiskMetrics-style daily convention; ATR_MIN_BARS=30 mirrors the existing W14 anchor; MIXED_MASS_SPLIT=0.5 and the uniform consensus prior 1.0 are parameter-free conventions. No threshold was fitted to any outcome sample.

oos_discipline.design_choices_influenced_by_run002: Root-cause DIAGNOSIS used Run-002 measurements (constant values, not outcomes). All repair parameters are a-priori conventions, not fitted numbers. The 133-case evaluation therefore measures the repaired system but is NOT an independent OOS proof of the repair choices.
oos_discipline.chronological_oos: The existing ChronologicalOOSEngine replays entire calendars through the full orchestrator (multi-hour per arm) and was not executed for this wave; its use remains possible for a future prospective gate.
oos_discipline.prospective_status: INCONCLUSIVE: no threshold or semantic choice in this wave may claim OOS predictive proof from these 133 cases. Final classification is architectural + descriptive.

evaluation_contract.scoring: src/simulation/historical_replay: _classify_actual_direction (dead zone 0.10), _decision_is_correct (BUY/UP, SELL/DOWN, HOLD/FLAT, NO_TRADE abstains), 1d/5d/20d
evaluation_contract.determinism: pass 1 vs pass 2: identical decisions and identical normalized numeric leaves for every case and variant
evaluation_contract.no_lookahead: all no_lookahead/payload/briefing/market checks must be true; any failure is a STOP

acceptance_criteria: See mission Phase 14; accuracy alone is not acceptance.
status_note: Registered PENDING pre-execution; verdict written post-run from measured artifacts only.
